title: Miao Ying's Corrupting Alchemy [8.1.0] [PLAYTEST]
author: wikuwi
description:
This mod reinvents beloved mechanics from other factions and integrates them for your Miao Campaigns

Steam Workshop Links:

<https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3754310516>

<https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3754311622>

Send feedback and report bugs to me directly please: rapypy (discord)

DLC required: The Warden and the Paunch (Grom cauldron + prison engine)

REQUIREMENTS & LOAD ORDER

Enable in Mod Manager top → bottom:

-

<https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3464018577>

-

Also required: The Warden and the Paunch DLC must be owned — the mod reuses Grom's cauldron and Eltharion's prison engine code.

Mod should work fine with SFO, Corrupted Landmarks

[[SPOILER]]

<https://www.loverslab.com/uploads/monthly_2026_06/image.png.ab4b4d8685990b19d18c34d8af4e4960.png>

[[/SPOILER]]

CURRENTLY PRESENT

-
15 alchemy recipes — 10 standard dishes + 5 secret recipes, each with custom art and story

-
25 unique ingredients across five ingredient groups, unlocked through battles, dilemmas, Sybarite trades, sea caravans

-
Jade Dungeon — Eltharion's prison re-imagined for Cathay: capture, execute, indoctrinate, interrogate, facility upgrades, Mist of Slaanesh

-
Chamber of Excess — Throt's Flesh Lab with Growth Vat batches, unit/monster augmentation, and Exquisite Ichor (Mutagen) on the resource bar

-
Lord ascension — Cathay lords corrupt into Slaaneshi forms at level 1, then ascend to exalted daemons at rank 15

-
Blessed Units recruitment tab — 25+ custom units (mechs, flyers, ogres, beasts) recruited with Mutagen; augmentable in the lab

-
Two landmark arcs — corrupted Skaven (Vermillion Veil) and corrupted Ogre (Hanyu Crucible) with capture missions + settlement landmarks

-
Campaign start swaps — neighboring Imperial Wardens / Celestial Loyalists replaced by two minor Slaaneshi migrant factions

CORRUPTION PROGRESSION — WHEN THINGS UNLOCK

Mechanics gate on Lazy's Miaoying Corruption Progression stages. Without Lazy loaded, systems stay at base tier.

Stage 1 — Jade Dungeon (prison panel, Jade Cage capture, Binding Essence, facility ring) · Lord corruption dilemmas when recruiting Cathay lords

Stage 2 — Miao Cauldron (cooking HUD, ingredients, recipes, milestones) · Sybarite Peddler · Grudge / Ogre capture missions issued

Stage 3 — Chamber of Excess (Flesh Lab, Growth Vat, augmentation) · post-battle Growth Juice · Exalted lord ascension at rank 15

Stage 4 — Cults and their construction through Alchemist hero new UI button, Underdeep teleportation mechanic for lvl 5 cults

[[/SPOILER]]

PORTED GROM'S CAULDRON MECHANIC

• Native COOKING feature pinned to Cathay / Miao Ying — same engine panel, Miao-skinned UI and animation

• 15 recipes with unique icons and lord/army/faction effects

• 25 ingredients with passive faction and army bonuses; Lua bridge applies passives on Cathay (vanilla Grom passives are faction-locked)

• Milestone tracker on the resource bar — cook 5 / 10 / 15 dishes for escalating ascension tiers

• 5 secret recipes require a signature key ingredient

[[SPOILER]]

<https://www.loverslab.com/uploads/monthly_2026_06/image.jpeg.557155ded3eabbe3888b11d3d04e5275.jpeg>

[[/SPOILER]]

PORTED ELTHARION'S PRISON MECHANIC — JADE DUNGEON

• Full Athel Tamarha prison panel reskinned for Cathay — upgrade ring, prisoner cells, execute / indoctrinate / interrogate

• Jade Cage army ability (Warden's Cage equivalent) — capture enemy generals in battle when you have an empty cell

• Autoresolve and manual battle capture; can imprison non-rebel faction lords if their faction survives

• Binding Essence pooled resource (engine: Warden's Supply) spent on facility upgrades

• Legendary prisoners yield stronger Daemonette rewards

• Facility upgrades rethemed: Pleasure Host Barracks (Corruptors chain), Damned Training Grounds (Ecstatic Iron Devil), Blissful Smithery (Fleshfire Cauldron Mech), Torture Chamber (Exquisite Ichor per turn), Blissful Defence (Prince's Blessings)

• Mist of Slaanesh — attrition on enemies, buffs on friendly armies; Shadows in the Jade Veil composite scenes spread from upgraded settlements across Cathay

[[SPOILER]]

<https://www.loverslab.com/uploads/monthly_2026_06/image.jpeg.9ae6fd5d02392a21deff9cba79afe39c.jpeg>

<https://www.loverslab.com/uploads/monthly_2026_06/image.jpeg.ffcf9c449fc2b9259e29eaeebef9f289.jpeg>

[[/SPOILER]]

PORTED THROT'S FLESH LAB — CHAMBER OF EXCESS

• Growth Vat with five upgrade clusters — batch rewards include Soil corrupted units and Blessed pool stock

• Unit Augmentation and Monster Augmentation on all added and eligible original units

• New flesh-lab upgrade nodes and Exquisite Ichor costs

• Exquisite Ichor (Mutagen) added to the campaign resource panel — spent on Blessed recruitment and lab actions

• Post-battle Growth Juice at corruption stage 3+

[[SPOILER]]

CATHAY LORD ASCENSION

• Stage 1+ — recruiting a Cathay lord prompts corruption: Magistrate → Chaos Sorcerer Lord, Shugengan → Herald of Slaanesh, Celestial General → Chaos Lord (Yin/Yang variants)

• Stage 3+ — corrupted lords at rank 15+ may ascend to Daemon Prince or Exalted Keeper of Secrets (rank halved on accept)

• Each ascended lord gets a Mutagen skill line and a fully replaced battle skill tree (Unyielding, Sure Aim, Blades of the Bastion, Fast Hands, rank-7 upgrades apply to mod units)

• Corrupted lords are hidden from normal recruitment — transformation is dilemma-driven only

[[SPOILER]]

[img https://www.loverslab.com/uploads/monthly_2026_06/image.png.96673274ca4596b8b1b81061ca80817f.png]

[[/SPOILER]]

LANDMARKS & CAMPAIGN MAP

Vermillion Veil — corrupted Skaven (Clan Grudge units)

• At corruption stage 2, a mission fires — capture the target settlement for a one-time army and unlock the landmark chain

• Landmark building recruits Vermillion Veil skaven: ratling, mirror vermin, noise chanters, chariot, and Sybarite lord

Hanyu Crucible — corrupted Ogres (Froeb roster)

• Same stage-2 mission pattern — capture settlement, receive army, build landmark for ogre recruitment

• Chaos Ogre Tyrant, bruiser hero ascension, dual fighters, warmongers, gnoblar forsaken, and more

Campaign start

• Imperial Wardens and Celestial Loyalists sent to North and South Poles — replaced by two minor Slaaneshi migrant factions from the north and south poles

BLESSED UNITS RECRUITMENT POOL

• Dedicated Blessed Units mercenary tab — stock earned from cauldron milestones, Growth Vat batches, Jade Dungeon facilities

• Each Blessed unit costs Exquisite Ichor to recruit and can be Unit Augmented or Monster Augmented

• Roster includes custom beasts, flyers, Slaanesh artillery, Chaos Dwarf mechs, ogres, Preytongs, Pleasureseekers, and more — 25+ units in miao-assets.pack, units are adopted from respective modders in credits, you don't need the original mods.

UNDERCITY CULTS

• Alchemist hero can now construct cults under your settlements with new UI button

• Fight off invasions, the once caused from appearing threats and others caused by upgrading the main building post stage 2, to stop appearing threats you need to fill all buildings slots with buildings, to stop the main threats you need to fight off from 3 to 5 invasions (randomized for each region)

• Cult buildings provide factionwide bonuses, as well as special army local abilities

• Some level 5 cults allow teleportation between them, zoom out the map to see possible locations

POSSIBLE ISSUES

-
This mod replaces Eltharion's original prison mechanic and reskins Grom's cauldron UI when playing Cathay — do not expect vanilla Yvresse/Greenskins prison or Grom cooking to behave unchanged

-
Throt's mutation on other factions should remain safe

-
Resource bar clutter: many HUD widgets can crowd the top bar. Some users report relief from also enabling:

-
<https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3259893195>

-
<https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3260081389>

-

changelog_latest:
Prefab:

1. 10 units

2. 15 landmarks, all with two stages with intent to build the full landmark from its ruined version

3. 10 post-landmark dillemas

4. 90% of schemes got changed

5. many-many effects

6. deep landmarks

7. forts with cathayan-slaanesh fort maps

8. changed Grand Schemes rewards (including getting your hands on Blue Scribes)

9. rifts are placed via deeps landmarks, the fort and the distant rift will be created at the theater as soon as the construction is finished

Fixes:

1. Fixed crash with JS Artillery

2. Fixed an issue with Dragonspawn ability

3. Fixed texts for Corrupted Ogre+Skaven landmarks

4. Fixed unit groups for some blessed units

Content:

1. Full Changeling Schemes loop ported to Miao — missions, grands, ultimate QB (retargeted to Miao Ying)

2. Theatre openers complete via deeps path landmarks (not Trickster cults)

3. Slaanesh corruption schemes (to 75), not Tzeentch

4. Form dilemmas changed to quest battles / vassalize, the now open sealed landmarks (T1 invasions to T2 stories)

5. New Rewards introduced and mergeg into Trickster’s rewards (abilities, ichor, grand bonuses)

6. Trickster Cultist contact changed to Exquisite Ichor +25/turn (stacks)

7. New rifts to the target Theatres are opened through special landmarks in Cathayan capitals ( those are portrayed in schemes in target theaters)

8. Slaanesh-styled dilemma reward icons + text

9. Lords can create forts now, forts have unique maps and provide regional bonuses
